title: Deterministic Reproducible Experiment Bundle
description: Reproducible research/breakthrough export: fixed seed, initial vs optimized metrics, noise citation, SHA-256 seal, and an explicit simulation badge. Identical seed + identical code version must reproduce the bundle bit-for-bit.

seed.description: fixed PRNG seed; identical seed ⇒ identical trace

noise.description: noise parameters verbatim from data/reference-library (T1/T2/ZZ, temperature, etc.)

codeVersion.description: git commit SHA of the producing run

citation.description: the data/reference-library citation backing the noise model

sha256.description: canonical-JSON integrity seal computed at export
